==========================================================================
citeseq-nf - R environment provenance record
==========================================================================

This is a snapshot of the R installation the pipeline was developed and
last run on. It is a record, not a spec: to rebuild the environment use
env/r_extra.R together with the conda environment file. Absolute paths,
user names and host names have been removed; '<env>' stands for the
environment prefix.

R version:            4.4.3 (2025-02-28)
Bioconductor release: 3.20  (BiocVersion 3.20.0, BiocManager 1.30.27)
Platform:             x86_64-conda-linux-gnu
Captured:             2026-08-04

Source column in the package table below:
  conda    - the package came from the conda environment (conda-forge /
             bioconda channels), so the conda environment file pins it.
  manual   - the package was added into the conda env afterwards with
             BiocManager::install() / install.packages() / remotes. These
             are the ones env/r_extra.R reinstalls.
  vendored - not on CRAN or Bioconductor; a source copy is kept in this
             repo under env/vendor/.
  base R   - ships with R itself (base or recommended priority).

Pulled in as a hard dependency of the above (needed at run time even
though no script names them). ThresholdR calls require(mixtools),
require(mclust), require(foreach) and require(ggplot2) from inside its
functions, so they are not visible in the sessionInfo attach list but
the pipeline fails without them. decontX imports celda.
